help.scope: Use for an ordinary residential closing. Enter the confirmed date and value and keep them in sync with your home purchase. Special buyer surtaxes and legal and processing fees are separate.
help.consideration: Enter the nominal CAD value used to calculate the charge on the closing date.
help.refund: Enter the verified eligible ownership share if the rebate is received at closing. Enter 0 for no rebate at closing.
help.mortgage: Enter 0 when there is no mortgage registration charge to include.
invalid.name: Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters.
invalid.jurisdiction: Choose Ontario, the City of Toronto, or Alberta.
invalid.date: Enter a closing date covered by the selected schedule.
invalid.amount: Enter a positive taxable amount in CAD.
invalid.facts: Enter valid housing, rebate or mortgage registration facts.
